title: Hearty Grilled Syrian Penne Pasta Grill
description: A flavorful and charred Syrian dish featuring penne pasta, this recipe is jain-friendly and perfect for a dinner meal, with a glassy-jelly texture from the monsoon Syrian sauce.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the penne pasta according to the package instructions until al dente, then set aside.
Brush the eggplant and zucchini with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper, then grill for about 5 minutes per side until charred.
Grill the garlic for about 2 minutes per side until slightly charred, then mince.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked penne pasta, grilled eggplant, grilled zucchini, and minced garlic.
Pour the monsoon Syrian sauce over the pasta mixture and toss to coat.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Sprinkle chopped fresh parsley over the top and serve hot.
